result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a failed image load on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section, which shows a generic broken-image placeholder instead of a photo.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, displaying a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of restaurant imagery. This is especially prominent as it's a large full-width card.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source URL or ensure the asset is available. Provide a branded fallback image or skeleton loader instead of a generic broken-image icon when the photo cannot be loaded.
